title: MNEMOS Active Agent
description: Records which actor is currently doing work in a project. Lives at ~/.mnemos/cache/<project>/active-agent.json. Updated by hooks on every tool invocation; read by statusline, SwiftBar, and vault panel.

agent.description: Identifier of the currently-active agent. Follows TEAM.md naming.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this agent became active.

context.description: What the agent is doing right now (best-effort).

tool.description: Tool name being invoked (Edit, Write, Bash, etc.)

verb.description: Action verb (read, modify, create, transition, etc.)

target.description: Resource being touched (file path, Jira key, repo name, etc.)

previous.description: Most recent agent transitions (bounded to last N entries; default 20).
